subject: Discovery recap and next steps — Mosaic Health integration
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@mosaichealth.com>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@mosaichealth.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap and next steps — Mosaic Health integration

Hi Oliver / Priya —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we’re aligned. Please flag anything I missed.

Key pain points you described:
- Latency spikes for multi-turn triage sessions during peak hours (up to ~1.2s/token today) impacting clinician workflows.
- High per-interaction cost on your current vendor for long-running chats with context retention.
- Need for structured output (diagnostic codes + confidence + provenance) to feed downstream EHR fields.

Goals you want to achieve (30–90 day horizon):
1) Reduce median inference latency by ~30% for 2–4k concurrent triage sessions.
2) Implement a deterministic structured output that maps to your internal FHIR-like schema.
3) Pilot an embeddings + rerank flow for note retrieval to cut hallucination rates in half for canned follow-ups.

Notes on integration areas we discussed:
- SDK changes: lightweight client patch to enable streaming + function-calling hooks. We proposed a new "streaming.funcall" flag so you can start streaming partial structured responses while function calls populate EHR fields.
- Function calling: Redwood can emit structured function-call payloads that match your handler signature; we’ll provide a compatibility shim for your lambda processors.
- Streaming: continuous token streaming with chunk-level checkpoints so you can surface interim findings to clinicians while the model completes.
- Embeddings/reranking: offline indexing to start, then a small online reranker model served via Redwood dedicated pool.

Immediate next steps (action owners):
- Redwood: share a starter SDK patch and API schema diff (attachment) by EOD tomorrow — Vanessa & Sergio.
- Mosaic: send a short sample of the FHIR-like output spec and a 1-week token/usage profile — Oliver.
- Schedule: tech deep-dive with your infra + engineering (30–45m) next Tue or Wed.

Attachments: mosaic_sow_draft_v1.pdf (SOW skeleton), api_schema_diff.patch (proposed API flags and minimal payloads).

If that looks right I’ll loop in Solutions Engineering for the deep-dive and draft a short mutual action plan.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0128

--
Redwood Inference — Production-grade LLM inference.

From: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@mosaichealth.com>

Cc: Priya Rao <priya.rao@mosaichealth.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2027 13:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery recap and next steps — Mosaic Health integration

Vanessa — thanks for the clear write-up. A few clarifications and one ask before the deep-dive: 

Clarifications:
- The latency target is relative to our current 1.2s/token median; a 30% reduction would put us near ~0.8s/token which would be a big win.
- For structured outputs we need the payload to include: ICD-10 candidate codes (top-3), a confidence score per code, and a source_span array that references the original clinician notes.

Ask:
- Can you include a short example of the function-call JSON shape that would return those fields? Our EHR team needs it to validate handlers.

I attached a short sample of our FHIR-like payload (mosaic_output_sample.json) and a 7-day token/usage export (mosaic_usage_week.csv).

Also Tuesday afternoon (Aug 17) PST works for the deep-dive for our infra + platform team.

Oliver Grant
Director of Product — Clinical AI, Mosaic Health
oliver.grant@mosaichealth.com | (206) 555-0142

Attachments: mosaic_output_sample.json (sample payload), mosaic_usage_week.csv (usage export)

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>

Thanks Oliver — this is great context. Picking up a few technical commitments from Redwood Solutions Engineering: 

- Example function-call shape: see quick example below (inline). We’ll put a formal spec in the repo patch.

On Thu, 11 Aug 2027 at 13:04, Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@mosaichealth.com> wrote:
> Vanessa — thanks for the clear write-up. A few clarifications and one ask before the deep-dive: 
> 
> Clarifications:
> - The latency target is relative to our current 1.2s/token median; a 30% reduction would put us near ~0.8s/token which would be a big win.
> - For structured outputs we need the payload to include: ICD-10 candidate codes (top-3), a confidence score per code, and a source_span array that references the original clinician notes.
> 
> Ask:
> - Can you include a short example of the function-call JSON shape that would return those fields? Our EHR team needs it to validate handlers.

Quick example (minimal):
{
  "function": "emit_diagnostic_candidates",
  "arguments": {
    "codes": [
      {"code": "J45.909", "confidence": 0.87},
      {"code": "R06.02", "confidence": 0.62}
    ],
    "source_spans": [
      {"start": 142, "end": 191, "text": "wheezing and shortness of breath"}
    ],
    "metadata": {"model_version": "rw-axl-1.2", "session_id": "sess-abc123"}
  }
}

Technical notes / action items from Redwood: 
- We will prepare a small SDK patch that toggles streaming.funcall and emits the above shape while preserving chunk boundaries for incremental UI updates.
- We’ll validate memory / KV cache sizing for 4k concurrent sessions to avoid cache thrashing — preliminary plan: pin a small model variant on Dedicated for the pilot.
- I’ll coordinate with Laura to produce bench numbers for token cost delta between current vendor and Redwood with our suggested batching and prefix cache settings.

Next steps:
1) Vanessa & I send the SDK patch + API spec by EOD today (12 Aug).
2) Schedule deep-dive for Tue Aug 17 at 11:00am PT — Vanessa to confirm final invite.
3) Oliver to share any additional redaction rules or PII handling constraints before the deep-dive.

Sergio Alvarez
Solutions Engineering Manager | Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.com

Attachment references: api_schema_diff.patch (will include streaming.funcall flag and example function-call shapes).
